desc: Ideation: model the problem as binary search + edge parity + MWIS edge-cover feasibility.
Implement `can(x)` for `x == 0`, required visits `r[i] = ceil(x / points[i])`, clipped high/low weights, prefix/suffix MWIS DP, and combine boundary states for every ending index `t`.
Implement `maxScore` binary search with safe upper bound `min(points) * m`, early return `0` when `m < n`, and early exits inside `can(x)` when moves exceed `m`.
Run the provided sample tests and a brute-force BFS/enumeration verifier for small n and m against the current solution; report whether it passes, and if not, identify the failing case.
